import csv
ids = {"ZN_1": "8a6a2103-e15c-58ff-a998-706690ba7cf8",       # Zone_F3_Z02 = Perimeter_top_ZN_1
       "ZN_2": "738ac87b-0db5-5085-9c36-eb153052549e"}       # Zone_F3_Z03 = Perimeter_top_ZN_2
data = {k: {} for k in ids}
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r = csv.reader(f)
    head = next(r)
    for row in r:
        d = dict(zip(head,row))
        if d['timeseries_id'] in ids.values():
            key = [k for k,v in ids.items() if v==d['timeseries_id']][0]
            data[key][d['timestamp']] = float(d['value'])
hours = ["2018-01-20T%02d:00:00" % h for h in range(8,19)]
for k in data:
    vals = [data[k].get(t) for t in hours]
    missing = [t for t,v in zip(hours,vals) if v is None]
    print(k, "missing:", missing)
    present = [v for v in vals if v is not None]
    print(k, "n=", len(present), "mean=", sum(present)/len(present) if present else None)
z1 = sum(v for t,v in [(t,data["ZN_1"].get(t)) for t in hours if data["ZN_1"].get(t) is not None]) / sum(1 for t in hours if data["ZN_1"].get(t) is not None)
z2 = sum(v for t,v in [(t,data["ZN_2"].get(t)) for t in hours if data["ZN_2"].get(t) is not None]) / sum(1 for t in hours if data["ZN_2"].get(t) is not None)
print("diff ZN_2 - ZN_1 =", z2 - z1)
